name: Tool Loop Guard
description: Detects agent tool-call loops: repeated identical failures, same-tool no-progress, and general no-progress cycles. Warning-first by default (warns via system context); hard-stop opt-in. Complements rate-limit-guard (which handles 429s). Ported from hermes-agent/agent/tool_guardrails.py.

warningsEnabled.description: Inject warning context when loop thresholds are reached (default: true)

hardStopEnabled.description: Block the tool call when hard-stop thresholds are reached (default: false)

exactFailureWarnAfter.description: Warn after N consecutive exact-same-call failures (default: 2)

exactFailureBlockAfter.description: Hard-stop after N consecutive exact-same-call failures, requires hardStopEnabled (default: 5)

sameToolFailureWarnAfter.description: Warn after N same-tool failures in a turn (default: 3)

sameToolFailureHaltAfter.description: Hard-stop after N same-tool failures, requires hardStopEnabled (default: 8)

noProgressWarnAfter.description: Warn after N tool calls with no apparent progress (default: 2)

noProgressBlockAfter.description: Hard-stop after N no-progress tool calls, requires hardStopEnabled (default: 5)
